action: Adds a cube, enters Edit Mode in Front Orthographic with X-ray on (key overlay 'Z', 'X'), and the cube has 5 faces.
tool: Add > Mesh > Cube, Edit Mode, shading pie (Z), Delete (X)
why: Start the body from one box; the deleted face is probably the mirror side
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(); then in bmesh delete the face on the -X side

action: Scales the cube to 0.211, places it on the chest of the front reference, and adds a Mirror modifier on X with Clipping and Merge.
why: Half-body modelling with a symmetric result

action: Moves vertices to trace the torso outline (chest to crotch) in front view, then adjusts depth in Right Orthographic.
view: Front Orthographic then Right Orthographic, X-ray
why: Match the torso silhouette to both reference views
reader_equivalent: bmesh: extrude bottom ring down, then set v.co for each vertex from measured reference coordinates

action: Shift-selects vertices and moves them in Y to shape the torso.
Extrudes the bottom leg face downward to make the thigh, then keeps extruding to the knee and ankle in Right Orthographic, scaling the end.
tool: Extrude Region and Move (E), Move (G), Resize (S)
view: Front Orthographic, then Right Orthographic, X-ray
why: Block the leg as a simple 4-sided tube
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.extrude_face_region(bm, geom=[leg_face]); translate new verts by (0,0,-0.36)

action: Selects the knee/shin ring and rotates it 9.73 degrees to follow the leg angle.
why: Match the leg's inward taper in the reference

action: Adjusts hip/crotch vertices slightly and checks the legs in solid view; undoes twice (Ctrl Z x2).
view: Front Orthographic X-ray, then User Orthographic solid
reader_equivalent: Set vertex co directly; no undo needed in a script, rebuild instead

action: Adds a vertical loop cut down the legs and torso to round them.
why: More edges so the legs read round instead of square
reader_equivalent: bmesh.ops.subdivide_edges(bm, edges=ring_edges, cuts=1, use_grid_fill=True) or bpy.ops.mesh.loopcut_slide with an override

action: Looks from below and selects the crotch/inner-leg vertices to clean the area where the two legs meet.
why: Fix the crotch topology between the mirrored legs
reader_equivalent: bmesh: pick verts near x=0 and low z; adjust co

action: Shift-selects crotch vertices and moves them slightly in Y.
In Object Mode, applies Shade Smooth (Keep Sharp Edges on) from the right-click menu and views the lower body against the reference.
why: Read the form without facet noise

action: Back in Edit Mode, selects a leg edge loop and scales it to 0.785 to slim the leg.
why: Taper the legs to the reference proportions
